hpi:
Differential: Myocardial infarction, myocardial ischemia, peptic ulcer disease, pulmonary embolism, aortic dissection, aortic stenosis, esophageal rupture, esophageal spasm, acute gastritis, GERD, coronary artery vasospasm, angina pectoris, esophagitis, cardiac tamponade.

This case is post myocardial infarction pericarditis (post-MI syndrome). Avoid treatment with NSAIDs other than aspirin. Acetaminophen or aspirin can be used for pain, and colchicine is optional because evidence is controversial. Diagnostics should focus on ruling out another myocardial infarction. Do not discontinue the patient's recent MI medications.
